concepts.def: Speech-like vocal style following the rhythms of text, used in opera and oratorio to narrate or dialogue.
Lyrical solo song expressing emotion at a moment of dramatic reflection, often in da capo form in baroque opera.
Recitative accompanied only by continuo, used for plot-advancing dialogue in baroque opera.
Recitative supported by orchestral accompaniment, reserved for heightened dramatic moments.
Male singer castrated before puberty to preserve a high vocal range, dominant in baroque opera roles like Handel's heroes.
Highly ornamented and virtuosic vocal writing, featured in baroque arias for technical display.
